subtopic: Moving to a new city on limited money
subtype: Approach: rely on a cousin's advice that does not fit the situation [Pitfall]
passage: Supervisor's note on a new joiner. Naveen arrived in the city in June on a modest starting salary. In the first week I noticed Naveen quoting a cousin, Afreen, who lives in a pricey neighbourhood and drives to work. "Afreen says that locality is the only sensible one," Naveen told me. So Naveen rented a small flat there, at almost half of the monthly pay, and started spending on the same kind of cafés and cabs. By the end of July Naveen was borrowing from colleagues for lunch. I sat down with Naveen and gently asked what the cousin earns and what Naveen earns. There was a long pause. Naveen said quietly, "I copied the choices without copying the income." We began a fresh list of options that fit.

qa.q: In which month did Naveen arrive in the city?
qa.a: Naveen arrived in the city in June.

qa.q: What did Naveen feel when the supervisor asked what the cousin earns?
qa.a: Naveen felt a pause of realisation and embarrassment, and said quietly the choices had been copied without the income.

qa.q: What could Naveen do next, and why?
qa.a: Naveen could list what income and needs are and search for a place that fits them, because a cousin's advice is only right for that cousin's situation.

qa.q: How might Afreen see the advice given to Naveen?
qa.a: Afreen probably meant well and did not know how much Naveen earns, so may feel surprised that the advice caused strain.

grounding: A newcomer copies a cousin who lives in a costly area with a car and picks a similar locality, and the budget strains because the incomes differ.

subtopic: Moving to a new city on limited money
subtype: Approach: rely on a cousin's advice that does not fit the situation [Pitfall]
passage:
Wednesday, 20 September.
Indu, write it down so you don't do it again.
When I got the Gurugram job, Simran didi said, 'Live near Golf Course Road, like me. Everything's close, it's safe, you'll love it.' She's been here six years. She has a car and earns about three times what I do. I didn't think about any of that. I just took a room two lanes from hers.
Rent is ₹16,000. My salary is ₹32,000. The metro is a fifteen-minute auto ride away, and autos here charge whatever they like, so it's ₹150 a day just to reach it. The only grocery shop nearby is the fancy one.
Today is the 20th and I have ₹2,100.
Didi's advice was right for didi. It was never about me. Next month I'm looking near a metro station, even if it's further out.

qa.q: What is Indu feeling on the 20th?
qa.a: Indu is worried and frustrated with ₹2,100 left, and a little embarrassed at copying without thinking.

qa.q: What should Indu weigh when looking near a metro station next month?
qa.a: Indu's own salary and daily travel, not someone else's lifestyle, comparing the total monthly cost of each option.

qa.q: Why does Simran didi's advice fit her but not Indu?
qa.a: Simran has six years in the city, a car and about three times the salary, so that area works for her and not for a newcomer.

grounding: Shows a newcomer copying a cousin's costly locality choice without accounting for the cousin's car and income, so the budget is strained.

passage:
Amandeep: I think I messed up the flat thing
Jatin: what happened
Amandeep: remember my cousin said Indiranagar is 'the only place to live'
Jatin: yeah
Amandeep: he's got a car and ten years of salary hikes. I've got a bus pass and a fresher salary
Amandeep: rent here is 18k. salary is 35k
Jatin: oof
Amandeep: plus I keep eating out because everything around is cafés 😩
Jatin: how much left this month
Amandeep: 3,400 and it's the 18th
Jatin: can you move?
Amandeep: lease notice is one month. giving it tomorrow
Jatin: good. look near your office this time, not near your cousin 😅
Amandeep: yeah. his advice was fine for him. I just copied it

qa.q: How does Amandeep feel about the flat decision?
qa.a: Amandeep feels regretful and a bit foolish for copying, and worried with only 3,400 left on the 18th.

qa.q: What should Amandeep compare when choosing the next flat?
qa.a: Distance to the office, the bus route and rent against a fresher salary, rather than where someone else likes living.

qa.q: How does Jatin see the situation?
qa.a: Jatin is sympathetic but practical, backing the move and gently teasing about looking near work, not near the cousin.

grounding: Shows a newcomer choosing a costly area on a cousin's advice though the cousin's car and income differ, straining the budget.
